method: PCA; full SVD; training data only

examples.description: size in training middle half; update recency in training middle half
size in training upper quartile; update recency in training middle half

scaling: Training-median imputation and unit-variance numeric scaling; one-hot categories remain 0/1.
interpretation: PC1 strata summarize training-feature variation. Inspect signed loadings and median profiles; component signs are arbitrary. Examples describe actual training objects only in coarse quartiles.
model_connection: Compare SVM + PCA with SVM using identical training CV folds and the same holdout. The prediction pipeline fits its own 90%-variance PCA within each training fold; this exploratory full-training PCA is never reused inside cross-validation.
limitations: PCA maximizes variance, not rating discrimination; low-variance signals can be lost.
One-hot prevalence and numeric outliers influence component directions.
The two-dimensional density map is not evidence that natural app groups exist.
Explained variance is a reconstruction diagnostic, not a clustering-stability result.
